title: Verify Administrator can return a part from a work order line
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Administrator role.
A work order line has a part that has been picked/received onto the line.
Note: per spec v33, returning a part from a work order requires NO permission - only Work Orders: View to reach the work order.
steps:
1. Open the work order and open the line that has the part.
2. Open the part's action menu and click Return (return part).
3. Confirm the return.
expected: The part return completes successfully; the part is returned off the line and inventory/return records update.
